{{Quote|Which family wears black?"''<br />''"None of them. That's the Chiss Defense Fleet. Black's a combination of all colors, since the military draws from all the families.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chak Fel]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
'''Defense Fleet uniforms''' were a type of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> used by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]],<ref name="Joiner King" /> including the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]]<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> and [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> 

==Description==
The Defense Fleet uniforms had shoulder patches in the color of one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]. [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officers]] wore a pair of silver bars on their collar indicating the owner's [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]], a military shoulder belt and an [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] holding a [[Chiss comlink]]. In the case of [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]], the bars were absent, although a smaller family shoulder patch was still present.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> Additionally, the uniforms could include a [[Holster/Legends|holster]] to carry a [[charric pistol]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

The Defense Fleet uniforms were [[Color/Legends|colored]] black, as this color was a combination of all colors, which signified that the military drew its members from all of the [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss families]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] officers were required to prove themselves similar to how the Ruling Families selected [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptives]] to be taken into the [[Defense Hierarchy]]. Upon promotion to a [[Senior officer/Legends|senior rank]] in the Defense Fleet, the officer was stripped of family name and privilege and made part of the Hierarchy in order that they may serve all Chiss without deference or prejudice. At that point, senior officers wore dazzling white uniforms. As with those not part of the Hierarchy, senior officers' white uniforms had a belt holding a Chiss comlink.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==History==
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date">{{OutboundFlightDate}}</ref> [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] wore a Defense Fleet uniform in the same black color as his warrior escort but with a larger burgundy patch on his shoulder and a pair of elaborately tooled silver bars on the collar.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The burgundy shoulder patch bore a yellow [[Unidentified Chiss crest|crest]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Wynssa Fel]], the younger daughter of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and [[Syal Antilles Fel]], wore a miniature version of the CEDF dress code during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="Force Heretic II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the cover art of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] incorrectly depicts Mitth'raw'nuruodo's black shoulder patch, the novel describes him having a burgundy shoulder patch in the color of Eighth Ruling Family,<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> as later correctly depicted in the ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" />
